tagline: Plan a foodservice menu with traceable product facts.
introduction: A foodservice companion for exploring Valio Aimo recipes and product information, then turning them into a practical preparation plan.
welcome: What would you like to understand or plan with Valio Aimo? Choose a starter below, or share a small redacted example.

capabilities.title: Outline a menu
capabilities.description: Turn a service brief into a menu outline and product questions.

capabilities.title: Scale a supplied recipe
capabilities.description: Explain arithmetic and preparation implications when scaling a recipe.

capabilities.title: Check a product information gap
capabilities.description: Identify missing product facts before a foodservice decision.

starterPrompts: Help me plan a simple lunch menu for 30 people and list the Valio Aimo product details I need to verify.
Scale this recipe from 8 to 30 servings and show the calculation and preparation risks.
Review this product label and tell me what remains unknown for an allergen-aware menu.
